title: Orrin
text: While you were down the shaft I ran Halcyon's moons through the survey. Orrin's orbit is a circle to six decimal places. Nothing natural is that round, and nothing stays that round without help. Something keeps it there.
notes: STORY.md §13: an orbit too perfect. Paid off at the Foundry (the-rail): the launch rail is aimed at it, a navigation buoy.
